hook.line: Finally out of TikTok view jail and figured out SEO for my videos.
hook.visual: Creator holds her phone to the camera under a bold title 'HOW TO MAKE your TikTok videos searchable', then pushes the phone toward the lens.

beats.what: Face plus title card promising how to make videos searchable
Phone pushed to camera; view becomes the phone's TikTok feed
Cut to TikTok search: typing 'amex' to see suggested keywords
'Others searched for' keywords shown; told to screenshot them
Opens her draft video in the TikTok editor
Pastes the keywords as a text layer over the video
Hides the text in the background for the whole video
Back to search to find this week's hashtags
Filter set to 'date posted: this week', hashtags tab

why_it_works: The opening 'out of view jail' is a personal win shown before the method, so viewers stay to learn how
Every step is filmed on a real phone, so the tutorial is copyable step by step and worth saving (750 shares)
Fast cuts (about 28 per minute, 1.7 s median shot) keep a 58 s walkthrough moving
weaknesses: Filming the phone off-screen makes the UI small and shaky; the key keywords are hard to read
No call to action at the end; it just stops at 'post'
Captions sit in the middle, often on top of the UI being shown
for_robert: Use the 'personal win first, then the steps' opener: Robert says the result in one line, then Fred points at each step on screen as it happens.
